title: Separate faithful bases, Morita equivalence, and reconstruction
what_it_would_establish: A precise comparison of detection of transformations, generation under operations, Cauchy completion, and recovery of a theory from its Set models.
known: Finite-limit recovery from finitely presentable models is established. Even finite sets give the Morita counterexample; the two-element object in FinSet opposite detects transformations without generating the product theory; the abelian-group example separates models from flat points.
residual: The intrinsic construction category Sigma on the late sheet is unfinished. No existing theorem is applied to it before its required preservation and accessibility properties are specified.
first_step: Put FinSet opposite, its even-cardinality subcategory, and the finite-product theory of abelian groups in one explicit comparison table. Compute each basis closure, Karoubi completion, model category, and flat-point category.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: A complete bounded mixed-envelope construction
what_it_would_establish: One precise universal envelope, with explicit operations, relations, 2-cells, and a proved stopping bound, for a single chosen small doctrine.
known: Kelly’s bounded completion and comodel results, modern sketchability theorems, and the exact biadjoint comparison explain substantial parts of the proposal. The cylinder/fold encodings and regular-cofinality repair are checked.
residual: The manuscript does not define every successor operation, prove local smallness for its unrestricted doctrine, or show that a small faithful basis generates operations. These are separate obligations.
first_step: Choose finite limits together with one explicitly bounded class of colimits. Define the missing K step and preexactness, then list the universal property required at each successor stage before taking any transfinite union.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: An exact cardinal dictionary for accessibility and filtration
what_it_would_establish: A corrected translation of every cardinal quantifier on these pages into presentability ranks, directedness, and the sharply-larger relation.
known: The countable-power counterexample, the singular-cardinal diagonal argument, and the distinction between filtered and aleph-one-directed presentations are proved. The checked modern rank theorem supplies the valid restricted statement.
residual: This is a commentary task with known mathematical outcomes. A sharper positive bound must state its cardinal-arithmetic hypothesis; the source’s exponent estimate cannot be simplified by notation alone.
first_step: Make a table of the source symbols pi, pi-prime, and cofinality bounds, translate each to a regular-cardinal convention, and attach the two explicit counterexamples at the failed quantifiers.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: Replace noetherian fppf point tests by an exact local model
what_it_would_establish: A concise explanation of why noetherian tests miss nilpotents and how a genuinely fppf-local test ring repairs that failure.
known: Schröer’s noetherian classification and the dual-number sieve give a complete negative answer to the noetherian proposal. Gabber–Kelly’s table deliberately treats other topologies under its stated hypotheses.
residual: A useful follow-up can work through one nonnoetherian fppf-local construction; it should not promise a new classification of all fppf points.
first_step: Start with the dual numbers over an algebraically closed field, identify the noncovering reduced sieve, and follow the exact construction of a local object that detects it in the opened fppf source.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: A worked inverse image of stacks and relative classifier
what_it_would_establish: One complete example of the comma-opposite 2-Kan extension, stackification, and the relative classifying 2-pullback with fixed underlying objects.
known: The corrected Yoneda statement holds for representables in the stated comparison. The stack inverse image requires the opposite comma category and stackification. The fixed-object classifier follows from the checked topos 2-pullback theorem.
residual: The final notation for a stack of slice topoi is not sufficiently developed to identify a theorem. That endpoint must remain separate from the valid structure-stack construction.
first_step: Choose a finite group action or a two-object algebraic structure on a simple site, write the actual descent groupoids, and compute the universal property of the relative 2-pullback.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: Internal component bounds and the torsor of decompositions
what_it_would_establish: A precise internal statement relating a finite Boolean idempotent algebra, a bound on connected factors, and the torsor of ordered decompositions.
known: The ordinary ring statement is proved, including the necessary finiteness of the Boolean algebra. Exact component rank is not preserved by arbitrary filtered colimits. Once a torsor is given, its pullback property follows from finite limits and epimorphisms.
residual: The construction of the sheaf of all decompositions through the proposed largest locus has not been shown to commute with inverse image. A chosen decomposition and an unstructured exact-rank property have different morphisms.
first_step: Write the rank-at-most-n condition as an explicit coherent formula, construct ordered decompositions for n=2 in a sheaf topos, and compare the result with the source’s e-prime-n before considering arbitrary base change.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: Formal smoothness and formal étaleness with fixed hypotheses
what_it_would_establish: A logical and categorical formulation of the relative algebra properties that the source groups together, with each lifting quantifier and finiteness assumption explicit.
known: The opened Stacks results identify formal smoothness, formal étaleness, finite presentation, and the ordinary local criteria. The source’s general list does not itself establish a geometric classifier for every property.
residual: Quantification over arbitrary square-zero extensions is not automatically a geometric formula. The correct restricted presentation must be fixed before claiming inverse-image stability.
first_step: Fix a finitely presented A-algebra B. Write its square-zero lifting condition in terms of a finite presentation and compare that condition with the exact smooth/étale criteria before changing the base to an arbitrary topos.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: Bicolimits and tensors for one accessible-category convention
what_it_would_establish: A theorem or counterexample for a single specified bicolimit or tensor operation, with rank and morphism conventions fixed.
known: The flexible-limit results and the locally presentable tensor construction are established. The checked finitary-doctrine bicolimit theorems concern more structured 2-categories than an unrestricted reading of Acc.
residual: The source’s broad bicolimit claim and merely accessible tensor interpretation are not settled by those nearby results. Changing between accessible and strongly accessible morphisms changes the question.
first_step: Choose either a bicategorical pushout of fixed-rank accessible functors or a tensor universal property. State the objects, 1-cells, 2-cells, and allowed rank enlargement before looking for a construction.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: Self-braiding, inverse pairings, and graded orientations
what_it_would_establish: A short common-invariant companion to the inverse-pairing question, the graded determinant conventions, and the Picard-groupoid obstruction.
known: The scalar epsilon(L), its square-one identity, the permutation-parity formula, and psi=epsilon(L) times the reversed pairing are proved. Both other archival endpoints have been read.
residual: The strictification question on the forms pages is stronger than the pairing calculation. The source’s sign exponent remains an ink question; parity 0/1 must not silently replace a written numerical sign.
first_step: Write the coherence diagram for the inverse pairing, evaluate it on an odd superline, and place the exact source formulas beside the graded-orientation and Picard self-commutor passages.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: A density and exact-Kan-extension companion
what_it_would_establish: An exact statement separating density, left-exact comodel relations, pointwise Kan extension, and the false cofinality shortcut.
known: The pointwise formula, restriction full faithfulness, and topos-target exactness are checked. Kelly’s comodel criterion gives the exact essential image. Explicit examples refute the source’s broader comma-finality and variance shortcuts.
residual: The remaining value is explanatory and historical. Any new theorem would need an additional, explicitly chosen target category beyond the already matched setting.
first_step: Draw the actual two comma categories in the source, verify their variance on a small example, and state precisely which colimit relations a functor on the dense subcategory must preserve.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.

title: A pseudofield and field-classifier algebraic companion
what_it_would_establish: A complete chain from the quasi-inverse equations and absolute-flat reflection to the corrected sheaf classifier of fields.
known: The Chinese-remainder presentation, uniqueness of quasi-inverses, reflection properties, and the corrected field topology match exact published sources. The canceled presheaf assertion is false, and regular-element invertibility is not geometric in the unqualified sense. The zero-dimensional ring site has enough points by the exact separable-topos theorem, after its countability hypotheses are checked.
residual: The proposed extension to every balanced bicomplete category lacks the needed exactness hypotheses. A worked categorical variant must name those hypotheses rather than extrapolate from topoi.
first_step: Present the two-component affine scheme and its universal quasi-inverse equations explicitly, then calculate the covering families that distinguish pseudofields from fields and preserve the canceled source passage beside its replacement.
origin: Present-run research-direction proposal from the cited archival records; not a claim of novelty.
